claims.evidence: NHS page: at least 10 appointments and 2 scans for a first baby; for later pregnancies the retrieved text says typically around 7, not 'at least 7'.
claims.newSentence: People having their first baby are offered at least 10 antenatal appointments and 2 ultrasound scans, and those who have had a baby before typically have around 7 appointments.

claims.evidence: NHS: booking is the first midwife appointment, ideally before 10 weeks; NICE NG201: booking appointment offered by 10 weeks.
NICE: inform the woman she can accept or decline any part of any of the screening programmes offered; NHS: screening is optional.
NHS and trust pages say timings and schedule differ by local service.
NHS page states at least 10 appointments and 2 ultrasound scans for a first baby (another NHS page says 'up to 10', see notes).
Retrieved text says typically around 7, not 'at least 7'.
claims.newSentence: People who have had a baby before typically have around 7 appointments.

claims.evidence: Same as c04; duplicate of c04.
NHS first midwife (booking) appointment page and trust pages: first appointment takes about 1 hour.

Retrieved NHS text says refer yourself as soon as you know you are pregnant and the first appointment should ideally be before 10 weeks; the exact phrase 'best to attend as early as possible' not seen. NICE by 10 weeks supported.
claims.newSentence: The NHS says the booking appointment should ideally happen before about 10 weeks of pregnancy, and NICE recommends offering it by 10 weeks.

claims.evidence: NICE NG201: staff discuss and offer screening for HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B, sickle cell and thalassaemia, and fetal anomalies at booking.

NHS trust pages: blood pressure and urine checks at most appointments; bump measurement and baby movements discussed from mid-pregnancy. 'Intervals' ok (visits more frequent from about 24 weeks). Trust sources, not main NHS page.
NHS 12-week scan: tells how far along you are and checks development; retrieved text does not mention showing more than one baby.
claims.newSentence: The scan offered at around 11 to 14 weeks, sometimes called the dating scan, shows how far along the pregnancy is and checks the baby's development.

claims.evidence: Scan usually at 18 to 21 weeks, called the anomaly or 20-week scan, looks at bones, heart, brain, spinal cord, face, kidneys, abdomen; screens for 11 physical conditions. 'Rare' not stated.
claims.newSentence: The 18 to 21 week scan, often called the anomaly or 20-week scan, looks at the baby's development and screens for 11 physical conditions.

claims.evidence: GOV.UK: combined test uses the dating scan nuchal measurement; Edwards' and Patau's screening is offered between 10+0 and 14+1 weeks and again at the 20-week scan if not done earlier; screening is optional. 'Offered at the dating scan' is too specific.
claims.newSentence: Screening for Down's, Edwards' and Patau's syndromes is offered in early pregnancy, and it is the woman's choice whether to have it.

claims.evidence: NICE NG201: inform the woman that she can accept or decline any part of any of the screening programmes offered.
NHS: flu vaccine free and recommended in pregnancy at any stage; whooping cough vaccine recommended each pregnancy.
NHS pregnancy pages give folic acid and vitamin D supplement advice with amounts (not repeated here, which is correct).
Local variation in schedule supported; the gestational diabetes example was not found in retrieved text (NICE says staff assess gestational diabetes risk at booking).
claims.newSentence: Local maternity services vary in the exact schedule and in what they include, so the local service's own plan is the reference.

notes: Only 5 searches used. Mixed NHS wording: main page says at least 10 appointments, another NHS page says up to 10; second sentence 'at least 7' not confirmed (found 'around 7'). c11 and c08 rest partly on trust pages and the NHS first-appointment page title, not full page text. c01/c05/c06 say 'mothers'; NHS wording is 'if this is your first baby', so inclusive wording used. Whooping cough and vitamin amounts not verified in full text beyond snippets. c04, c07 and c05/c06 duplicate each other; consider deduplicating.
